content.jointProblem: Can uncertainty-aware policy geolocation and hail-specific spatial modelling identify underpriced farm exposures more reliably than municipality-level loading in Vojvodina? The first experiment would test whether rainfall-downscaling methods transfer to hail using independently observed hail events and verified policy locations, before evaluating incremental pricing value on held-out storms and years.

rationale.text: Pejić has directly relevant regional experience developing field-scale weather-data pipelines for agricultural insurance, although the demonstrated hazard is rainfall rather than hail.

sources.quote: RAINFIELD developed and validated a production-grade geostatistical downscaling pipeline for converting coarse-resolution satellite precipitation products into field-scale (1 km) daily rainfall grids

rationale.text: His work provides a concrete geostatistical method to investigate as a baseline, with comparative validation on northern Serbian precipitation data.

sources.quote: This study applied kriging with external drift (KED) to downscale 10-day accumulated rainfall to a 1 km grid over northern Serbia
Leave-one-out cross-validation showed that KED reduced RMSE by 21% relative to ordinary kriging and by 34% relative to IDW

rationale.text: He has experience designing independent, fine-scale validation rather than treating a finer output grid as proof of finer predictive accuracy.

sources.quote: This study deployed a temporary network of 18 tipping-bucket rain gauges at 300–600 m spacing
These measurements were withheld from the downscaling model and used exclusively for validation.

rationale.text: His insurance research explicitly connects spatial resolution to field-level basis risk, relevant to investigating the weaknesses of municipality-level exposure assignment.

sources.quote: Index insurance products that trigger payouts based on area-average rainfall can suffer from basis risk
This study quantified how the choice of precipitation grid resolution (0.25°, 0.05°, and 1 km downscaled) affects the properties

rationale.text: A joint project matches his explicitly stated collaboration interests.

sources.quote: joint projects on spatial weather data products for agri-insurance or precision agriculture

constraints.text: Policy-to-field linkage must distinguish verified locations from settlement-level approximations and propagate location uncertainty rather than assign false field-level precision.

sources.quote: a large share of our farm addresses are stored only at the settlement level, not as coordinates.

constraints.text: The available daily, five-kilometre weather feed cannot be assumed to resolve local hail footprints; hail-specific reference observations and spatial validation must precede operational field-level claims.

sources.quote: We do receive daily gridded weather data from MeteoVoj d.o.o. at a five-kilometre resolution
a storm can devastate one village and leave the farm two kilometres away untouched.
both methods underestimate peak rainfall cells associated with localised convective events.

constraints.text: Evaluation must respect the limited claims history and correlated storm losses, using storm- or year-held-out tests rather than relying only on random policy splits.

sources.quote: We have three full claim years with geo-tagged loss data for about 1,200 farm policies to work with.

constraints.text: The deliverable must support automated pricing ingestion through the existing Python batch workflow, not stop at manually produced GIS maps.

sources.quote: turning that into something that feeds the pricing model automatically is beyond what our team can do alone.
Python-based batch scoring pipeline for quarterly rating factor refresh

constraints.text: Scope, handover and maintenance must fit a company without a dedicated research unit and with shared operational staffing.

sources.quote: The company has no dedicated research unit
a four-person pricing team and a six-person IT team who split their time between operational support and new product build.

risks: Rainfall interpolation, rainfall-deficit insurance and rain-gauge validation do not establish hail-intensity estimation capability. The first experiment may show that additional hail observations or specialist expertise are indispensable.
Settlement-only policy addresses may prevent meaningful field-level attribution; geo-tagged claims may not locate every insured asset or supply unbiased validation across the portfolio.

Three years may contain too few independent hailstorms to distinguish durable exposure effects from chance. Higher claim costs could also reflect asset values, coverage or repair-cost changes rather than hail intensity alone.
Researcher availability and project capacity are unknown despite confirmed interest in joint projects; ongoing supervision does not establish spare capacity.
Budget, delivery deadline, weather-data licensing, access to independent hail observations and permissions for policy-data processing are unknown.
Operational integration could stall: the company's earlier flood-risk mapping collaboration was completed but has not been integrated into pricing.
questions: What time and staff capacity can Pejić commit, and who will provide hail-specific meteorological expertise if the initial transfer test requires it?
Does MeteoVoj provide actual hail observations or estimates, radar-derived products, event timestamps and uncertainty information, and do its licences permit research and operational pricing use?
Can cadastral parcels, insured-building coordinates or verified field boundaries be recovered, and what exactly do the existing loss geotags identify?
Are complete policy exposures, sums insured, premiums, coverage terms, deductibles, claim dates and non-claiming policies available for all three years?
Which independent hail-event reference data can support the first experiment, and what accuracy, calibration and held-out pricing-improvement criteria would justify proceeding?
What budget, deadline, data-protection arrangements and procurement limits apply, including any purchase of radar data or collection of new observations?
Who owns production integration and maintenance, what interface and actuarial explanation are required, and how should delivery accommodate the planned Guidewire migration?
